The trust was already there. / The system wasn't

Criar Sin Culpas already had what many practices spend years trying to earn: trust, expertise, and an audience. But that value lived across disconnected formats and platforms. The engagement became the work of turning it into a support system parents could use and the practice could sustain.
What began with voice became an owned system for support, learning, product, and operations.

source_en: Each protocol supported the moment. / Each use taught us what came next.
Protocols were both interventions and product tests. They showed what parents reached for first, what language helped, and where immediate relief needed to become continued support.
The strongest value was not more content. It was practical relief, navigable language, and continuity.
EVIDENCE Testing plan · Free support experience → signals → deeper structured offer
Observed site behavior in a 91-day reporting window shaped how support and pathway decisions were prioritized.
Pantallas reached 71 visitors with 72% average scroll depth .
A familiar, immediate conflict became the strongest protocol entry point.
Keep urgent, recognizable needs at the front of the public support layer.
Desbordes reached 41 visitors, 79% average scroll depth , and 108 seconds average time on page.
Parents did not only sample acute-support content. They stayed with it.
Prioritize concise intervention first, with enough depth to support understanding after the immediate moment.
67 unique visitors triggered portal_entered, approximately 30% of the 223 visitors in the reporting window.
A meaningful share moved beyond an individual page into the broader support environment.
Continue developing an owned pathway rather than treating protocols as isolated content.
Visitors actively used the bilingual capability.
Treat bilingual delivery as experience infrastructure, not a translation layer.
We initially assumed the opportunity was to organize educational content. Behavior showed that parents first needed immediate, navigable support. That changed the architecture.
Build a support ecosystem, not a content library.
Free protocols handle the moment. Deeper programs build capacity before the next one.
Free support → Evidence → Deeper support → New signals
